glosses: operation (the method or practice by which actions are done)
operation (a procedure for generating a value from one or more other values)

examples.text: ¿Cuántas operaciones ha realizado el doctor Jackson este mes?
examples.en: How many operations has Dr. Jackson performed this month?
Do you wish to make any other transaction?

examples.text: La operación tenía que mantenerse en secreto.
examples.en: The operation had to be kept secret.

examples.text: La operación de Tom iba a costar una pequeña fortuna.
examples.en: Tom's operation was going to cost a small fortune.
